Resolve the battery for a pass (family-conditional enrolment, Stage-0 SS3.3)

Source: R/registry.R
resolve_battery.Rd

Enrols a lens iff: its tier is allowed; its family predicate passes; its feature support covers the formula; the log-likelihood is producible (native or via the family spec); the adapter is implemented in this build; and, for a koine-authored lens, its validation evidence is on record (the open-arms correctness gate, SS11 — an unvalidated first-mover abstains). A lens that fails any test is excluded with a recorded reason — a logged absence, not an error (I1).

Usage

resolve_battery(pass, registry = koine_stage1_registry())

Arguments

pass

A koine_pass.

registry

A registry list; defaults to koine_stage1_registry().

Value

A list with enrolled (lens specs) and excluded (list(id =, reason =) records).

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(30), x = rnorm(30))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
resolved <- resolve_battery(pass)
vapply(resolved$enrolled, function(L) L$id, character(1))
#> [1] "dram"         "nimble_gibbs" "dream_zs"     "robust_t"     "horseshoe"   
#> [6] "lasso"        "ridge"
